name: area
description: The area chart is based on the line chart, filling the area between the line and the axis to emphasize the trend of quantity changes. It can better show the peaks and valleys in trend changes, using the visual effect of the filled area to highlight the degree of change in quantity over time. Area charts are particularly suitable for displaying continuous time-series data, intuitively expressing the trend of data changes, and emphasizing the change in the total amount within a certain interval through the visual effect of the area. When it is necessary to display data from multiple series at the same time, a stacked area chart or a percentage stacked area chart can be used to compare the proportion of each category in the total and its change over time.

data.description: Data for area chart, such as, [{ time: '2018', value: 99.9 }].

stack.description: Whether stacking is enabled. When enabled, area charts require a 'group' field in the data.

style.description: Style configuration for the chart with a JSON object, optional.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the chart, such as, '#fff'.

lineWidth.description: Line width for the lines of chart, such as 4.

palette.description: Color palette for the chart, it is a collection of colors.

texture.description: Set the texture for the chart, optional, default is 'default'. 'rough' refers to hand-drawn style.

theme.description: Set the theme for the chart, optional, default is 'default'.

width.description: Set the width of chart, default is 600.

height.description: Set the height of chart, default is 400.

axisXTitle.description: Set the x-axis title of chart.

axisYTitle.description: Set the y-axis title of chart.
